page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, aligning the instance with compute-focused hardware profiles.

The instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to the dedicated CPU allocation and the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for compute-intensive workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of excess memory. It is suitable for batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and application servers where compute density is prioritized over large memory footprints or local storage IOPS.
